title: 75th Tsukukoma Festival!!
content:
So guys, it's time for the 75 Tsukukoma school festival!!!

## What's a school festival (just in case)
School festival, especially in Japan, means a big event (actually huge) that visitors from outside can play games/ watch performance/ eat food in school. It's like making the school into a large playground.

## What we have here
We get many many many things going on! Each class will make their own stuffs (whether it's a video game, a movie, a play...), and you can actually play it. The highschool area usually have gambling simulators, VR games, plays, movies, and escape rooms. Our class (1-3) is making pachinko & slots (google it).

## Stage performance
We have plays, Mr.Tsukukoma, Ms.Tsukukoma(It's a boy's school btw), Kaisei VS Tsukukoma (google Kaisei), and many things...that we flex our "knowledge".

If you're in Tokyo, please come to our school festival cuz we need money :(  Please help us improve our environment...
Here's the link for everything 

[Tsukukoma School Festival Official Site](https://tsukukoma.bunkasai.info/)
